changes.title: Named personal experiments follow future history
changes.text: Keep a question, exact captured populations and metric in a separate atomic registry; reopen results against current history, inspect missing data/conditions/uncertainty/contributors and manage definitions. Unknowns remain unknown and observational differences are not causal claims.

changes.title: Verify persistent experiments and preserve TEST302
changes.text: Ten core methods plus native recording/save/reload/future-run result and pointer checks. Preserve existing exact questions, navigation, outcomes, settings/hotbar, exports, all prior tests, history, signing and player feature gates.
